source_rows.quoted_intake: Improve the bound Var(log Z_n) = O(n/log n) for directed polymers in random environment in general dimension to a power improvement n^{1-eps}.
source_rows.primary_source: Sourav Chatterjee, Chaos, concentration, and multiple valleys, arXiv:0810.4221v2, Section 8 and Section 12(3), https://arxiv.org/pdf/0810.4221

source_rows.primary_quote: Improve the fluctuation exponent in directed polymers.
source_rows.corrected_statement: The cited model has i.i.d. standard Gaussian vertex weights on nonnegative Z^2, directed up/right paths of n vertices starting at the origin, and M_n equal to the maximum path-weight sum (zero-temperature ground-state energy with sign reversed). Theorem 8.1 proves Var(M_n) <= C n/log n. Problem (3) asks to improve that fluctuation exponent. A proposed precise strengthening is: there exist constants epsilon>0 and C<infinity such that for every integer n>=2, Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon). The last sentence formalizes the question; it is not verbatim from the source.
source_rows.verdict: FIX the intake: log Z_n and general dimension are unsupported by the cited problem and change the mathematical object and domain.
